card.text: Explore Ida in 3D with cssEarth using archived spacecraft imagery and source-backed shape data.

introduction.text: Galileo’s 1993 flyby revealed Ida’s cratered surface and its tiny moon Dactyl.

normal.title: SSI monochrome mosaic
normal.summary: Photographed shadows remain and detail varies across the mosaic. Brightness is not calibrated reflectance; the grid marks gaps.

calibrated.title: Calibrated Galileo photographs
calibrated.summary: These two Galileo photographs show overlapping parts of Ida’s surface. Both were taken through a green filter. The original sunlight and shadows remain visible; the grid marks areas without usable photographs.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Height relative to a 16 km sphere, from the shape model. Colors include Ida's broad form; the outline is simplified.
